title: Flexible Work and Workplace Attendance
summary: Defines role-based work-location expectations, team anchor days, temporary remote-work arrangements and manager responsibilities without creating a universal office-day quota.
key_controls: Roles are classified as site-dependent, hybrid or remote-eligible
Hybrid teams publish anchor days at least thirty days in advance
Attendance data is used for capacity and safety rather than individual productivity scoring
Temporary arrangements require an end date and documented review
exception_route: Employees request an exception through HR Operations; medical or disability-related requests follow the accommodation process and are not decided solely by the line manager.
common_question: Can a manager impose additional office days immediately?
clarification: A manager may respond to a documented operational need, but material recurring changes require HR review, reasonable notice and consistent treatment across comparable roles.

title: Leave, Accommodation and Wellbeing
summary: Establishes consistent leave notification, confidential accommodation review, return-to-work planning and non-retaliation requirements across Meridian locations.
key_controls: Managers receive only the work restrictions needed to implement an approved accommodation
Employees are not required to disclose diagnoses to line managers
Unplanned absence notifications may be made by a representative when the employee cannot notify directly
Statutory or local benefits prevail where they are more protective
exception_route: HR Operations and the regional People Partner decide leave and accommodation exceptions with Legal or Occupational Health input when required.
common_question: May a project reject approved leave because of a release milestone?
clarification: A project may propose coverage and handover arrangements but cannot cancel protected or already approved leave outside the formal HR review process.

title: Performance, Learning and Internal Mobility
summary: Governs goal setting, evidence-based performance reviews, development planning, internal applications and the use of project feedback in employment decisions.
key_controls: Performance conclusions require documented evidence from the review period
Project telemetry and AI-generated summaries cannot be the sole basis for a rating
Employees may apply for internal roles without manager permission
Critical-role transitions use a documented handover rather than an indefinite transfer block
exception_route: The People Partner reviews disputed ratings, delayed internal transfers and conflicts involving a hiring manager or current manager.
common_question: Can project utilization or activity data determine a performance rating?
clarification: Utilization may provide context where relevant, but it cannot substitute for agreed outcomes, quality, behavior, constraints and documented manager judgment.

title: Acceptable Use, Endpoint Security and Remote Access
summary: Defines acceptable use of Meridian systems, managed-device requirements, security monitoring, software installation, remote access and loss reporting.
key_controls: Restricted data is accessed only from managed devices unless an approved exception exists
Multi-factor authentication is required for remote access
Users report lost devices and suspected credential exposure immediately
Personal use must be limited, lawful and must not interfere with operations or security
exception_route: IT Service Management records the request; Information Security performs risk review and the business owner accepts any residual risk.
common_question: May an employee forward work files to a personal account to meet a deadline?
clarification: No. Schedule pressure does not authorize movement to unmanaged storage; IT must provide an approved access or transfer method.

title: Identity, Access and Privileged Administration
summary: Sets joiner-mover-leaver controls, least privilege, access recertification, service-account ownership and elevated-access safeguards across Meridian systems.
key_controls: Every account maps to an accountable person or registered service owner
Privileged work uses a separate elevated identity with step-up authentication
Managers and application owners recertify access on the defined schedule
Emergency access is time-bound, monitored and reviewed after use
exception_route: Information Security approves time-bound exceptions after application-owner justification and compensating controls are recorded.
common_question: Can a shared administrator account be retained for operational convenience?
clarification: Shared privileged credentials are prohibited except for an approved emergency mechanism that preserves individual attribution and post-use review.

title: Data Classification, Retention and Generative AI
summary: Combines Meridian data classification and retention rules with controls for approved generative-AI services, human review and prohibited sensitive-data use.
key_controls: Information is labeled Public, Internal, Confidential or Restricted
Retention follows the record category rather than an employee's convenience
Restricted data is not entered into generative-AI services without an approved use case and technical controls
AI output requires accountable human review before business use
exception_route: The Data Owner, Privacy, Legal and Information Security jointly review exceptions involving Confidential or Restricted information.
common_question: Does removing names make customer or employee data safe for any AI tool?
clarification: No. Re-identification, contractual restrictions, sensitive attributes and tool terms must still be assessed through the approved-use-case process.

title: Procurement and Third-Party Onboarding
summary: Defines competitive sourcing, conflicts disclosure, purchase authority, security and privacy review, contract ownership and vendor offboarding.
key_controls: A purchase request precedes commitment to a supplier
Requesters disclose conflicts and do not approve their own spend
Vendors handling Meridian data complete security and privacy review before access
Contract owners track renewal, performance, data return and offboarding
exception_route: Procurement documents sole-source or emergency justification; Finance and the relevant risk owner approve before commitment whenever practicable.
common_question: Can a team start a free software trial before vendor review?
clarification: Only when no Meridian or personal data is entered, no integration is enabled and the trial creates no contractual or automatic-renewal commitment.

title: Travel, Expense and Corporate Card
summary: Sets pre-approval, safe travel, reasonable-cost, receipt, corporate-card, personal-expense and approver-accountability requirements.
key_controls: Travel is booked through approved channels unless safety or availability requires an exception
Claims identify business purpose and are submitted within thirty days
An employee cannot approve their own expense
Personal corporate-card charges are repaid promptly and repeated misuse is escalated
exception_route: The Travel Program Manager reviews booking exceptions; Finance reviews tax, receipt and repayment issues; Security supports elevated-risk travel.
common_question: Is the lowest available fare always mandatory?
clarification: No. The reasonable option may account for safety, total journey time, accessibility, changeability and material productivity impact.

title: Workplace Access, Visitors and Business Continuity
summary: Governs badges, visitors, secure areas, incident reporting, emergency communications, site closures and continuity responsibilities.
key_controls: Badges are individual and lost badges are reported immediately
Visitors are registered, identified and escorted according to area risk
Tailgating and attempts to bypass access controls are challenged or reported safely
Business functions maintain tested continuity contacts and recovery procedures
exception_route: Facilities approves access exceptions with Security review for restricted areas; the incident commander controls temporary rules during emergencies.
common_question: May an employee lend a badge to a colleague who forgot theirs?
clarification: No. Reception or Security must verify the colleague and issue approved temporary access so entry remains attributable.
